data.text:
Senator Panfilo “Ping” Lacson wants the government to hand over some of its biggest and costliest infrastructure headaches to the country’s richest tycoons — as was done after Typhoon Yolanda — starting with San Miguel Corp. boss Ramon S. Ang’s offer to solve Metro Manila’s flooding at no cost to taxpayers.

“Assuming RSA is given the authority and actually performs what he offered to do before our plenary debates on the 2026 budget bill, I will move to reduce the DPWH and MMDA appropriations for the flood management program in the NCR during the period of individual amendments,” Lacson said, referring to the Department of Public Works and Highways and the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority.
